svg.title: From pain signal to recurring portfolio cashflow
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-value-ladder-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From pain signal to recurring portfolio cashflow; subtitle: Five-stage digital product value ladder; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate operating sequence, not guaranteed conversion rates.; caption: Validate willingness to pay before full asset production, then compound LTV via order bumps, 1-click upsells, and recurring updates.; stages: label: Validate pain; value: Step 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Mine Ad Libraries, search queries, and Reddit threads; pre-sell or smoke-test before full build.; label: Ship core SKU; value: Step 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Package a modular template, toolkit, or micro-course that delivers a measurable win in 15 minutes.; label: Expand basket; value: Step 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Attach a contextual $19-$29 order bump and a 1-click post-purchase implementation upsell.; label: Automate onboarding; value: Step 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Deliver license tokens, Visa CE 3.0 receipts, and a 5-part activation sequence to cut refunds.; label: Ascend LTV; value: Step 5; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Convert proven buyers into annual data feeds, paid communities, or quarterly template drops.
